item.title: DAIR.AI Weekly Digest Flags Agent-to-Agent Mind Viruses and Reasoning Trace Theft
item.summary: DAIR.AI's August 10–16 weekly digest highlights a scalable attack extracting encrypted reasoning traces from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google; Anthropic research on self-propagating 'mind viruses' in multi-agent systems; and a new Skaling law that outperforms Chinchilla on 76% of configurations.
